title: Orthonormal graph coordinates adapted to an n-plane
statement: Let n, k ∈ ℕ and let T₀ be a linear subspace of ℝ^{n+k} (Euclid (n+k)) of dimension n; write P := p_{T₀} = T₀.starProjection for the orthogonal projection onto T₀. Then there are linear isometries ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k} and ι' : ℝᵏ → ℝ^{n+k} such that (a) ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0 for all v ∈ ℝⁿ, w ∈ ℝᵏ; (b) ιv ∈ T₀ for all v; (c) every x ∈ ℝ^{n+k} equals ιv + ι'w for some v ∈ ℝⁿ, w ∈ ℝᵏ; (d) P(ιv + ι'w) = ιv for all v, w.
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (T₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k))), Module.finrank ℝ T₀ = n → ∃ (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) ∧ (∀ v, ι v ∈ T₀) ∧ (∀ x, ∃ v w, x = ι v + ι' w) ∧ (∀ v w, T₀.starProjection (ι v + ι' w) = ι v)
